name: Grilled Pork Burger with Basil Yogurt, Plum & Arugula-Tomato Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place pork, bread crumbs, Worcestershire sauce, and spices in a large bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the pork mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 plums
3 tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the basil yogurt. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pit. Cut each half into thin slices. Place on another plate and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Set aside a small handful of arugula for each burger, then add remaining arugula to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Spread basil yogurt over the bottom half of each bun; top with reserved arugula, burger patties, and plums. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
